metrics.profile_summary: Strategy and Operations professional with 8+ years of experience across enterprise technology, telecom, and luxury retail. Expert in executing growth initiatives, leading large cross-functional teams, and managing complex B2B projects.

experience.description: Leads enterprise solutions operations for Telecom, M2M, IoT, and Cloud services, focusing on client retention and cross-functional team performance.
Supported enterprise growth and operational alignment via GSM, M2M, IoT, and Cloud solutions for corporate clients.

experience.role: Business Development Manager – Strategic Partnerships & Execution
experience.description: Led regional market expansion in Southern Pakistan and executed go-to-market strategies for global premium brands.
Led a 34-member cross-functional team managing high-value commercial real estate project lifecycles and delivery.
Drove revenue growth through structured client engagement, pipeline management, and market analysis for commercial real estate.
Oversaw operations and contract management for multiple projects, negotiating over 30 commercial contracts.
Supported operational planning, reporting, and vendor coordination across ongoing projects.

strengths: Strong people management experience (led teams up to 34 members)
Experience with GTM strategies and market expansion
weaknesses: No mentioned experience with GA4 or ad platform reporting
Lacks experience in consumer brand (B2C) integrated campaigns
Background is heavily focused on Operations and B2B Enterprise rather than Marketing
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly skilled Operations and Strategy leader, but lacks the specific digital marketing technical stack (GA4, ad platforms) and consumer-facing brand experience required for this role.
